'''Harrod''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]],<ref name="CSWE" /> within the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Its [[Harrod's Planet system/Legends|system]]<ref name="Atlas" /> contained a single habitable [[Planet/Legends|world]], known simply as [[Harrod's Planet]].<ref name="CSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The star Harrod was mentioned in the [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. Its creation was based on Harrod's Planet,<ref name="CSWE" /> which originated in the [[1990]] ''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Paul Murphy]] as a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="RAS">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Harrod's Planet [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Harrod itself, in grid square M-5.<ref name="Atlas" />
